🚨 Scary moment at UFC last night… but good news on Raoni Barcelos! In the main event of UFC Fight Night (Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos) in Las Vegas, Brazilian bantamweight warrior Raoni Barcelos (22-6) was putting on an absolute war against young prospect Raul Rosas Jr. Barcelos was ahead on the scorecards heading into Round 5 of a Fight of the Night battle. Then at 1:38 of the fifth, Rosas hit a trip/slam takedown against the fence. Barcelos suddenly went limp and lost consciousness on impact — no big strike, just a bizarre and terrifying finish. He stayed motionless on the canvas, was stretchered out of the Octagon, and rushed to a Level 1 trauma center. Rosas immediately stopped fighting and later asked everyone to pray for him. Huge respect. UPDATE: UFC confirmed Barcelos is stable, alert, and responsive with full movement after a CT scan and full assessment. He’s being monitored in hospital under medical supervision. His team (including coach Davi Ramos) also said he’s okay and told fans to stay calm. Sending all the love and recovery vibes to Raoni — true warrior who gave us an unforgettable fight. Get well soon, champion! 💪🇧🇷 Drop a 🙏 in the comments for Raoni! #RaoniBarcelos #UFC #UFCVegas #MMA #GetWellSoon
